patches.title: rel0-3-0: Sidecar 0.3.0 mods (default, recommended)
patches.description: The mods for Sidecar 0.3.0: everything in rui1027d, plus projects keyed by the Rytm's slots (SAVE AS / copy / clear follow, the project trash), kits following SAVE / RELOAD KIT, NO + KIT / PATTERN reload on the Sidecar's pages, the poly sequencer's pages and keys (FUNC + YES undo, FUNC + DOWN menu), the SIDECAR MENU with WEB UI (the pairing code), and a freeze probe that reports a stuck Rytm screen to the Sidecar. The same file elekloader builds from core 0.1 + rytm-sidecar-0.3.0.elemod (sha256 893ed9a5...733ab). Needs Sidecar 0.3.0 on the Pi.

patches.title: rui1027d: Sidecar 0.1.0 / 0.2 mods + remote pages (older)
patches.description: Everything in sfx1021, plus the remote pages: a connect screen when the Sidecar comes up, and with TRK + YES the SIDECAR and SYSTEM status pages, SCOPE and meters, the LFO page (TRK + LFO), the REC page with playback and channel picking on the trig keys (Sidecar on the Pi) and the voice pages, in the Rytm's own font, on Sidecar Mini and Sidecar; the SRC view (the Sidecar machine's page on the Rytm's own SRC page); the Rytm's FX return on IN L/R for recording and SCOPE. The page catches only the keys and knobs it uses: PLAY / STOP / RECORD always reach the Rytm, pads, mutes, FILL and tap tempo work as usual.

patches.title: sfx1021: Sidecar mods without the remote pages
patches.description: External voice machines (PLAITS, DAISYSP, JUNO, FM, DIGIDRUM, DSP SAMPLE and user machines) on every track, the SEND FX 1/2 pages (AMPLITUDE 2; TYPE and P1..P5 with the Sidecar's FX labels, stepped lists), and the SIDECAR folder in the sample browser. The same mods as rui1027d without the remote pages.
